Honorable Debbie-Anne A. Reese, Secretary
Federal Energy Regulatory Commission
888 First Street, N.E.
Washington, DC 20426

          Re:      PJM Interconnection, L.L.C., Docket No. EL25-49-000, et al.
                   Compliance Filing in Docket No. ER26-1088-000

Dear Secretary Reese:

       This letter, being served on all parties to the above-referenced proceeding, confirms
that PJM Interconnection L.L.C (“PJM”) submitted today a Compliance Filing of Tariff
changes in Docket No. ER26-1088-000 (Accession No. 202601205251) in accordance with
the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission’s December 28, 2025 order. 1 PJM has
requested approval of the Tariff changes effective as of the date the Commission accepts
the Compliance Filing.


                                                          Respectfully submitted,

                                                          /s/Ruth M. Porter
